dedupe_keys.name: ericsson mobility report data and forecasts

description: The Ericsson Mobility Report publishes measured and forecast figures on mobile networks worldwide, including mobile data traffic in exabytes per month, the traffic share of 5G, data use per smartphone, fixed wireless access and subscriptions by technology. Forecasts cover ten regions, from North America and Western Europe to Sub-Saharan Africa and India with Nepal and Bhutan, and currently run from a 2025 baseline to 2031, when total mobile data traffic is expected to reach about 328 exabytes per month, roughly 2.2 times today's level. Ericsson measures traffic in a large base of live networks and publishes full reports twice a year, in June and November, with quarterly traffic updates; the Mobility Visualizer web tool lets users view and chart the forecast data by region and indicator. Coverage: global and ten regions, measured history and forecasts over about six years. Format and access: web pages, report PDFs and the interactive visualizer; free to view, with no bulk download. Caveats: a vendor's own methods and assumptions; forecasts are revised each edition; figures can be quoted with attribution but reuse terms are Ericsson's. Simulation uses: demand scenarios for capacity planning of mobile, backhaul and data-centre networks, and growth assumptions in energy and resilience studies. Related records: ITU ICT statistics give country-level indicators, and the Telecom Italia big data challenge gives city-level traffic.
